local_controls.scope: Pure matcher/parser plus five owned temporary metadata files; no real jobs root or production main. Added true target B, shared-tuple wrong-size zero-read, wrong-hash exclusion and cross-target stdin negative controls.

review_findings: Each candidate must match one complete fixed execution tuple: executable, argv, cwd, env and four resource fields. Only those metadata candidates may open fixed stdin.bin.

A held stdin length outside every candidate target length is rejected before any stdin bytes are read. Same-length wrong-hash inputs are excluded. Neither class outputs unrelated job IDs, request pins or input text.

A match is published only after its own target stdin length+SHA and held/named job-directory identity pass; each record carries the specific target label. Common argv or resource fields cannot substitute for the per-target stdin pin.

Each target separately reports EXACT_MATCH_OBSERVED/MULTIPLE_EXACT_MATCHES_OBSERVED/NOT_FOUND_AT_OBSERVATION with execution_state UNKNOWN. Metadata does not prove execution or the original idempotency key; no automatic replay.

All unchanged UID1000/no-follow/regular ownership/FD cleanup, 4096 entries, 128KiB request, 32MiB total, checked10s deadline, 8 exact records and 64KiB output gates remain. The collector request still uses CPU1/128MiB/nice10/30s.
